title: Enforce auto eligibility and record autonomous authority
name: auto-eligibility
description: Implement the selected authority boundary so auto can act only under explicit invocation, with zero open decisions anywhere on the board. Recheck before brief approval, dispatch and acceptance; refuse missing or malformed board state, overlaps, claims, stale decisions, unsafe base (including main) and missing verification. Record that approval and acceptance were autonomous rather than attributing them to an unobserved human. Include tests for concurrent board changes and the attended path.
